## Heights

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| messages: false
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(flextable)
```

```{r}
heights <- heights
```

```{r}
heights |> 
  filter(income < 300000) |> 
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(x = height, y = income)
  ) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(formula = 'y ~ x', method = "lm")
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
heights |> 
  is.na() |> 
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
heights |> 
  summary()
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
# package vtable 
# must be installed
heights %>% 
  select(
    -marital, 
    -sex
    ) %>% 
  # . to stop RStudio 
  # complaining about 
  # no data
  vtable::st(data = ., out = "return") |> 
  as_flextable(
    show_coltype = FALSE,
    max_row = 30
  ) |> 
  line_spacing(
    space = 0.3
  ) |> 
  delete_part(
    "footer"
  )
```
